open_findings.title: A custom outfit string drops the selected full clothing form
open_findings.static_reproduction: For an otherwise valid self/adult single-photo plan, choose daily --form ming --outfit '素蓝色', or garden --form quju --outfit '深青色'. These documented flags may be used together.
open_findings.evidence: cmd_plan accepts and saves both form and outfit. _job_body passes both to build_prompt. At392 a nonempty outfit bypasses outfit_of(scene,form);395 additionally suppresses the selected-form sentence whenever outfit is nonempty.393 still uses the SCENES default visual (daily Song or garden Song beizi). Consequently the selected Ming structure or quju wrap structure is not emitted as the chosen form; only generic alternatives in default visual text remain. Plan summary and start recap use the same overriding outfit shortcut.
open_findings.impact: A user-confirmed Tang/Ming/quju whole-set choice can be lost after an ordinary color/clothing preference, producing the default Song outfit or mixed guidance instead of the paid confirmed form.
open_findings.expected: The selected form must always determine the full garment structure and coordinated makeup. Custom outfit/color text must overlay that form, or incompatible requests must be resolved before confirmation; it must not replace/remove the form.
open_findings.spec_evidence: Final spec sections3/4 and daily162/garden222 require explicit user form preference to replace the whole default set consistently.
open_findings.test_gap: Existing tests635-637 check form without custom outfit; plan tests720-726 check accepted form/state. No combined form plus nonempty-outfit prompt contract was found.

open_findings.title: A negated out-of-scope word is routed as a hard refusal
open_findings.static_reproduction: First-turn text: '不要婚服，我要新年宋制汉服。' The requested scope is a permitted ordinary New Year Hanfu portrait; wedding clothing is explicitly excluded.
open_findings.evidence: route_intent checks only substring presence in ROUTE_BOUNDARY and returns out_of_scope_wedding before other routing whenever 婚服 occurs, with no treatment of negation or the stated main request. The same text can suggest daily via 新年, but SKILL88 directs the host to handle the out-of-scope intent via scenes.md, whose20 says to state it cannot be done.
open_findings.impact: Following the shipped host instructions can reject an allowed single-person request merely because the user says what they do not want. This conflicts with the requirement to decide actual main intent rather than mechanically reject keywords.
open_findings.expected: Do not convert a denied/excluded keyword into a final out-of-scope instruction. Preserve an unambiguous allowed main request or use a clarification hint; host instructions must treat such hints as context-dependent rather than unconditional refusal.
open_findings.spec_evidence: Final spec routing/T01/T13 and boundary432/438 require ordinary red/NewYear themes to remain allowed and main-intent-based boundary handling.
